title: Bio page
subtitle: A page with your most important links to paste into your Instagram or TikTok bio.

intro.title: A page just for your bio
intro.description: Bring your most important links together on a page that looks like you. Paste the address into your Instagram bio, TikTok, or anywhere else — no need to squeeze everything into one link.

gate.title: Your links page, on your own address
gate.description: Your bio page is published on a custom address of your own — something like yourname.linkcharts.com.br. You don't have an address yet: create your first one to publish your page. It also works for your short links.

steps.build: Build the page with your links
steps.share: Paste the address into your Instagram or TikTok bio

legacyBanner: Choose your page's address to continue.

sections.identityHint: How you introduce yourself at the top of the page: photo, name and description.
sections.publishingHint: The page is published on a custom address of your own — e.g. yourname.linkcharts.com.br.

avatar.label: Profile photo
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 2MB.

removeDialog.title: Remove profile photo?
removeDialog.body: Your page goes back to showing the title's initial instead of the photo.
